prioritized_experiments.hypothesis: If we formalize and incentivize Salesforce consulting partner referral program (revenue share on referred customers), we can achieve 40 partner referrals/month vs. current 8/month, generating 300% ROI.
prioritized_experiments.methodology: Launch structured referral program with 5 consulting partners: clear commission structure (15% of ACV year 1), marketing enablement (1-pager, case study, training), monthly business reviews. Track referrals sourced vs. partner engagement.
prioritized_experiments.resource_requirement: 0.25 FTE (partnership manager) + marketing team support (1-pagers, case studies)
prioritized_experiments.roi_if_successful: 10:1 (for every $1 spent on program, $10 MRR generated in year 1)
prioritized_experiments.go_no_go_decision_criteria: If partner referrals reach 15+/month by week 6, scale to 10 partners. If <5/month, pivot to partner enablement (webinars, training).
risks: Partners prioritize other vendors (mitigate: strong incentives + regular engagement)
Referral quality poor (mitigate: MQL definition agreed upfront with partners)

prioritized_experiments.hypothesis: If we secure 2-3 analyst briefings (Gartner, Forrester) and 1 editorial placement (Dark Reading, Information Security Magazine), we can achieve 15% lift in lead quality + 20% lift in sales team win rates due to credibility halo.
prioritized_experiments.methodology: Identify 5 key analysts covering insider threat space, submit 3 analyst briefing requests (Gartner, Forrester, IDC). Pitch 3 industry publications for thought leadership article. Track analyst mentions in sales calls + article-sourced leads.
prioritized_experiments.target_impact: +15% lead quality (MQL-to-SQL conversion), +20% sales win rate from credibility
prioritized_experiments.resource_requirement: 0.2 FTE (exec/marketer for analyst relations) + product team input on briefing prep
prioritized_experiments.roi_if_successful: Credibility lift worth $20-30K in additional MRR (from improved conversion rates)
prioritized_experiments.go_no_go_decision_criteria: If 2+ analyst briefings + 1 editorial placement secured by week 8, codify into quarterly analyst relations playbook. If <1 placement, deprioritize and redirect budget.
dependencies: Requires sales team feedback on lead quality and objection patterns
risks: Analyst/editorial processes slower than expected (mitigate: 60-day timeline realistic, start immediately)
Analyst skeptical of new vendor (mitigate: strong Gartner report positioning + customer proof points)

prioritized_experiments.hypothesis: If we shift content focus from generic 'insider threat awareness' to specific proof points (ROI calculator, compliance checklist, competitor comparison), we can improve content-driven lead quality from 0.2 conversion rate to 0.35+, reducing CAC from $800 to $550.
prioritized_experiments.methodology: Create 3 core assets (ROI calculator, compliance checklist, DataShield vs. Varonis comparison). Promote via LinkedIn, email, partnerships for 6 weeks. Track lead source, conversion rate, and lead quality (MQL → SQL rate).
prioritized_experiments.target_impact: +75% of content leads convert (vs. current 20%), reducing CAC from $800 to $550
prioritized_experiments.resource_requirement: 1.0 FTE (content marketer) for asset creation + promotion
prioritized_experiments.roi_if_successful: If successful, content becomes primary lead source (currently most expensive). Reduces overall CAC by 5-10%.
prioritized_experiments.go_no_go_decision_criteria: If content-driven conversion rate reaches 30%+ by week 6, scale content production 3x. If <15%, revert to awareness content and reallocate to partnerships.
dependencies: Requires sales input on top customer objections and proof points they find most persuasive
risks: Content takes longer to gain traction (mitigate: promote heavily via paid + partnerships)
ROI calculator data requirements (mitigate: partner with financial modeling tool)

prioritized_experiments.hypothesis: If we recruit 5 early customers for customer advisory board + speaking opportunities, we can unlock case study content + customer referrals, adding 15 new leads/month with 0.25 CAC ratio (high quality).
prioritized_experiments.methodology: Select 5 customers with strong NPS + visible Salesforce usage. Invite to quarterly advisory board + speaking opportunities (security conferences, webinars). Track advisor-sourced referrals and speaking-generated leads.
prioritized_experiments.target_impact: +10 leads/month with <$100 CAC (customer referral), high conversion quality
prioritized_experiments.roi_if_successful: Customer referrals typically have 3-5x higher conversion rate + 2x higher LTV
prioritized_experiments.go_no_go_decision_criteria: If 3+ customers commit to advisory board by week 3, scale to 10 customers. If <2 commitments, deprioritize.
dependencies: Requires CS team to identify customers with high advocacy potential
risks: Customers lack time for advisory program (mitigate: clear time commitment, professional fees if needed)
Speaking opportunities limited (mitigate: create internal thought leadership program)

prioritized_experiments.hypothesis: If we hire fractional SDR (0.5 FTE) to do personalized LinkedIn outreach to 500 CISO targets/month with relevant case studies, we can achieve 8-10% reply rate and 2-3% meeting rate, generating 10-15 qualified opportunities/month with $800 blended CAC.
prioritized_experiments.methodology: Hire fractional SDR to conduct LinkedIn + email outreach campaign targeting CISO personas. Personalize messaging with relevant proof points. Track reply rate, meeting rate, qualification rate.
prioritized_experiments.roi_if_successful: If 2% of outreach converts to customers, ROI is 3:1
prioritized_experiments.go_no_go_decision_criteria: If reply rate reaches 8%+ and meeting rate 2%+ by week 4, scale to full-time SDR. If reply rate <5%, deprioritize.
dependencies: Requires email sequence and personalization templates from content team
risks: SDR productivity varies (mitigate: clear KPIs, weekly check-ins)
CISO outreach fatigue (mitigate: personalized, valuable outreach vs. mass spam)

experiment_sequencing: Execute experiments in parallel but with sequence logic: (1) Partnership acceleration (#1) and analyst relations (#2) run immediately (non-resource-intensive, highest potential impact). (2) Content optimization (#3) runs weeks 3-6 (informs partnership enablement). (3) Customer advocacy (#4) runs weeks 2-4 (quick launch, builds momentum). (4) SDR testing (#5) runs weeks 5-10 (requires SDR hiring). Learnings from partnerships inform SDR targeting. Content assets created in #3 directly support SDR outreach in #5.

success_playbook_opportunity.if_top_experiment_succeeds: Partnership acceleration becomes core growth engine: scaled from 5 to 15-20 partners, formalized referral operations, partner enablement program becomes quarterly ritual.
success_playbook_opportunity.scaling_path: Months 1-2: Validate with 5 partners, establish commission structure and enablement. Months 3-6: Add 10 more partners with proven playbook. Months 6+: Build partner portal with self-service resources, shift to partner community management.
team_capability_to_build: Partner enablement at scale (training programs, marketing resources, deal reviews)
Revenue operations (partner commission tracking, MQL-to-SQL attribution)

month_1: Content Marketing Optimization (create ROI calculator, checklist, comparison)
month_2: Partnership Acceleration (track referrals, add 5 more partners if successful)
SDR Testing (hire fractional SDR, launch outreach campaign)
month_3: Launch 2 new experiments based on learnings
Plan Q2 roadmap based on Q1 learnings

pause_if: Partner/analyst/customer engagement drops <25% of target within 2 weeks
SDR reply rate <5% after first 500 outreaches
Content conversion rate plateaus <25% after 4 weeks
kill_if: Partnership: <5 partner referrals/month by week 6 (kill analyst relations first, reallocate budget)
Analyst Relations: 0 analyst briefings scheduled by week 8
Customer Advocacy: <2 customers commit to advisory board by week 3
scale_if: Partnership: 15+ referrals/month by week 6 → expand to 15-20 partners
Analyst Relations: 2+ briefings confirmed → formalize into quarterly analyst relations program
Content: 30%+ conversion rate by week 4 → double content production budget
Customer Advocacy: 3+ customers in program by week 3 → hire dedicated advocate manager
SDR: 3%+ meeting rate by week 4 → hire full-time SDR
